title: Chapter 260 Formal Alliance
content:
Chapter 260 Formal Alliance

Almost everyone present had paid protection fees.

"Now, the main force of Nanshanji has been defeated, but Nanshanji is not that easy to break. I feel that I am weak, so I hope to get everyone's support."

Wang Shuo's words were high-sounding.

Everyone knows very well that with the current strength of Wana Village, it will be easy to defeat Nanshan Ji.

But the meaning of Wang Shuo's words is already obvious, that is, he wants to give some benefits to everyone.

Anyone who can become the leader of a village is not stupid.

Many lords immediately echoed: "Master Alliance Leader, if you have any requests, just give them! We in xxx Village will do our best."

Everyone is carrying the sedan chair!

"Okay, this operation is part of our Nanshan Guild's crusade against the oppression of Nanshan Ji. To the lords in the Guild who are willing to participate in the operation, after Nanshan Ji is captured, we will distribute the spoils according to the merit."

"Everyone, do you have any objections?!"

Wang Shuo glanced around.

"Lord Wang, we have not joined the Nanshan Association yet, can we join now?"

"Yeah, last time you gathered, we were too far away and couldn't catch up!"

Wang Shuo also knew that these people just didn't bother to come last time.

But he didn't say anything.

"Of course, our Nanshan Association is originally intended to support each other in this troubled time. There is no reason to reject everyone."

"However, if you join the Nanshan Club, you must abide by the rules of the Nanshan Club!"

Wang Shuo's words made the previous lords beat drums in their hearts. They didn't mention the rules of the Nanshan Meeting before.

Seeing everyone's doubts.

Wang Shuo said quickly: "As the saying goes, there is no rule, and the most basic rule is that every lord must implement the decision made after we all discuss it, and must not violate it."

In this operation, many people in Nanshanji were regarded as outsiders. This was Wang Shuo's intolerable behavior.

Hearing Wang Shuo say this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

"Of course it should be like this. Otherwise, what's the point of the Nanshan Association that we all formed?"

Liu Zhiming from Gaotang Village, who had responded positively before, immediately said righteously.

Everyone lowered their heads and thought, this is indeed the truth.

If you want freedom without any restrictions, you don't have to join the Nanshan Society.

If you encounter difficulties later, or are bullied by others and are left alone, you can only admit that you are unlucky.

Just like collecting protection money in Nanshan, you can only break your teeth and swallow it.

If everyone formed an alliance, the situation would definitely be different.

After figuring this out, the lords present joined in one after another.

The trend is established.

The Nanshan Meeting organized by Wang Shuo finally had the appearance of an alliance.

Next, we need to use various means and interests to firmly tie everyone to this chariot.

Wang Shuo immediately ordered someone to kill the sheep and make an oath.

A lord provides a guild order.

Wang Shuo formally established the Nanshan Society.

[Do you want to use a gang building order? 】

"yes."

[You can choose to form one of three organizations: alliance, gang, or mercenary group. 】

Wang Shuo chose an alliance, named it "Nanshan Society", and added the lords who were willing to join to the alliance.

At this point, the Nanshan Society is no longer a verbal organization, but an alliance recognized by the system.

At this moment, the barriers between all the lords seemed to be loosened.

Before, they were still on guard against each other, as the other party might attack them at any time.

Now, this concern is much lessened.

Everyone was smiling and toasting to each other.
